description: Sewerage Network Main Pipelines is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Corporation. Layer containing sewer main centrelines and associated details. Includes sewer name, description, asset section (for As Constructed drawings) and key attributes for gravity mains, pressure (rising) mains, effluent reuse / recycling pipes. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Corporation. Its tags are assets, mains, melbourne water, sewer main, sewerage. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
